planets.name: Kepler-409 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-409 with a 69-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-409 b was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-409. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BONOMO_ET_AL_2023): disc_year 2014, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 68.95832161, pl_radj 0.1069678, pl_bmassj 0.01887811

quotes.title: Kepler-409b
quotes.card: Kepler-409b is a super-Earth orbiting Kepler-409, a G-type main-sequence star.
quotes.introduction: Its orbital period around the star is 69 days.
